A showcase is a finished solution that you can import and open. It is the fastest way to see how something real is built. Agentivity offers four.

![The step Try a solution of the welcome guide, with the four showcase cards: CV Screening, Invoice Clerk, Shopping Lab and Trip Manager Team, each with what it contains](images/four-showcases.jpg)

## The four showcases

| Showcase | What it does | How it is built |
|---|---|---|
| [Invoice Clerk](/docs/showcases/invoice-clerk/) | Reads the supplier invoices you upload, files each one, checks its figures and charts the totals. | One agent with three tools, and one data table. |
| [Shopping Lab](/docs/showcases/shopping-lab/) | Compares a product across two stores and writes a report with the best picks. | A team of nine agents that work one after another, and five data tables. |
| [Trip Manager Team](/docs/showcases/trip-manager-team/) | Plans a full trip with the traveller. The bookings and the payment are simulated. | A team of thirteen agents led by a manager, and two data tables. |
| [CV Screening](/docs/showcases/cv-screening/) | Compares a CV with a job description and proposes what to do with it. | One workflow with thirty-four elements. |

Together they cover the three building blocks: one agent, two teams with two different patterns, one workflow.

## Which one to open first

| You want to learn | Open |
|---|---|
| What one well-equipped agent can do | **Invoice Clerk** |
| How to give tools and a table to an agent | **Invoice Clerk** |
| How a chain of specialists works | **Shopping Lab** |
| How agents pass work through tables | **Shopping Lab** |
| How a manager sends work to specialists | **Trip Manager Team** |
| How a person decides during the work | **Trip Manager Team** |
| How fixed steps, AI steps and approvals mix | **CV Screening** |

Start with **Invoice Clerk**: it is the smallest, and you can read all of it in a few minutes.

## Import a showcase

1. In the Studio, open **Templates**.
2. Select the card of the showcase, then **Import**.
3. In the window **Import a Template**, select **Import**.
4. Select **Open it**.

The machine where Agentivity runs needs an internet connection: the showcases come from the Agentivity marketplace. See [Try a ready-made solution](/docs/getting-started/try-a-ready-made-solution/).

## Before you run one

- **You need a model connection.** The import makes the agents use yours. See [Connect an AI model](/docs/guides/connect-a-model/).
- **An execution costs.** Each agent that works uses the AI model, and your provider bills you. Trip Manager Team has thirteen agents and Shopping Lab has nine: one request uses the model many times.
- **They are examples.** They show how to build. Read their instructions and adapt them before you rely on one for real work.

## Each showcase is a solution

Each showcase carries the tag `solution`. If you use a portal, the four appear in it as soon as they are imported. See [Show a team in the portal](/docs/vibeapps/show-a-solution-in-the-portal/).
